title: Keep environments separate
summary: Local and hosted projects have different addresses and keys.

blocks.text: Local and hosted projects have different addresses and keys. A clear environment setup prevents practice code from changing real data.

Use the Supabase local CLI with its required container runtime, then run supabase init and supabase start in a practice project. Use the local URL and public key reported by its status command. SQL runs in the local database tools.

blocks.code:
Local development: local URL, local public key, fictional sample rows.
Hosted app: its own public URL/key and reviewed policies.
Server-only operations: secret key kept out of browser bundles.
Before running changes: verify which project the client points to.
blocks.title: Keep environments separate

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: The local URL and key choose the practice project.
A frontend build exposes its included configuration, so server secrets need a separate server-only location.

blocks.text: The worked checklist keeps the practice project and a real app from being confused.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Environment variables included in a frontend bundle are visible to users. A variable name does not make a secret safe.
